blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, ORIENTAL MINDORO, Philippines — Police arrested the province’s sixth most wanted person in an operation in Barangay Mina de Oro, Bongabong town, on Sunday night, Sept. 13. The suspect was arrested at 7:08 p.m. by personnel of the Bongabong Municipal Police Station (MPS), in coordination with the 2nd Provincial Mobile Force Company, Oriental Mindoro Police Provincial Office, 403rd Battalion Mobile Company of the Regional Mobile Force Battalion, Provincial Intelligence Team Oriental Mindoro, and Regional Intelligence Unit 4B.
